race.comment: WILD ROMEO (5) has set down the platform to peak and win now. Only just missed the frame last start over 900m at Corowa, beaten 4 lengths into fourth after being prominent at the corner. Peak fitness now and in the right race to find winning ways. RED HOT ROSIE (2) was another that was handy in the run last time out before fading late to finish 4.5 lengths away over this trip at Kembla Grange. Easier here. Home track return for STILL THE MOON (7) who was well in commission on his debut over 1000m at this track back on April 21 and finished fifth, beaten 3 lengths. Will be better at prep number two and is expected to go well. SHEEZASPEEDQUEEN (11) is on debut and has the right profile to figure in the finish.
